ValidationRule.description: Fours/Sixes must be 0 or more, and their runs cannot exceed Runs Scored or Balls Faced.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(BLANKVALUE(Fours__c, 0) < 0, BLANKVALUE(Sixes__c, 0) < 0, (BLANKVALUE(Fours__c, 0) * 4 + BLANKVALUE(Sixes__c, 0) * 6) > BLANKVALUE(Runs_Scored__c, 0), (BLANKVALUE(Fours__c, 0) + BLANKVALUE(Sixes__c, 0)) > BLANKVALUE(Balls_Faced__c, 0))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fours/Sixes must be 0 or more, and their runs cannot exceed Runs Scored or Balls Faced.
